title: [QM] Destination bin code is now visible and usable for the user
summary: Quality Management now allows users to select and use destination bin codes when creating manual transfer orders, with bin selection validated for bin-mandatory locations.
key_points: Manual Create Transfer Order in Quality Management gets a destination bin selection
Bin can only be selected for bin-mandatory, non-directed destination locations
The chosen bin is validated against the selected destination location
The selected bin is stored in Transfer-To Bin Code on the transfer line
A new permission set, QltyMgmt - Bin View, was added
quote: Add destination bin selection to the manual Create Transfer Order action in Quality Management.
